cfg.title: Codex History Viewer
cfg.sessionsRoot: Root folder of Codex sessions. Leave empty to use the default (~/.codex/sessions).
cfg.codexArchivedSessionsRoot: Root folder used when Sources: Enabled includes Codex and Codex Archived Sessions: Enabled is on. Leave empty to use a sibling archived_sessions folder next to the Codex sessions root.
cfg.codexArchivedSessionsEnabled: Load Codex archived_sessions in addition to normal Codex sessions when Sources: Enabled includes Codex. When enabled, the Archived Sessions Root setting below determines which archive folder is read.
cfg.claudeSessionsRoot: Root folder of Claude Code sessions. Leave empty to use the default (~/.claude/projects).
cfg.branchNavigationEnabled: Experimental setting. Enable Branch Navigation for locally forked Codex histories and Claude Code histories created with Fork conversation. Codex forks created in a new worktree are not supported. Off by default.
cfg.sourcesEnabled: Select one or more history sources to use in History, Pinned, and Search. Removing Codex also disables the Codex archived-session settings.
cfg.handoffEnabled: Show cross-agent handoff actions for visible Codex and Claude Code sessions. Turning this off hides handoff creation, copy, and open actions, but handoff-file deletion and status information remain available.
cfg.previewOpenOnSelection: Open a reusable session preview in the editor area when selecting a tree item.
cfg.previewMaxMessages: Maximum number of user/assistant messages collected for detailed tree item tooltips. This is not a guaranteed visible count. VS Code limits hover height to about 50% of the window, so some collected messages may be outside the visible area when the tooltip is long.
cfg.previewTooltipMode: Choose how much information session tree item tooltips show.
cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumFull: Show date, source, CWD, tags/note, message excerpts, and action help.
cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumCompact: Show metadata only, without message excerpts or action help.
cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumTitleOnly: Show only the same one-line text shown in the tree item.
cfg.searchMaxResults: Set the maximum number of hits collected by one search.
cfg.searchCaseSensitive: Choose whether searches distinguish uppercase and lowercase letters.
cfg.searchDefaultRoles: Select one or more message roles to use in searches.
cfg.searchIndexToolContent: Choose how much tool content is stored in the search index. Including tool content can help File AI Change History prioritize related sessions.
cfg.searchIndexToolContent.enumConversat: Search only user, assistant, and developer messages. File AI Change History still works, but related-session prioritization may be less precise because file-name hints are limited.
cfg.searchIndexToolContent.enumToolCalls: Search messages plus tool names and arguments, without tool output.
Search messages, tool names/arguments, and tool output.
cfg.deleteUseTrash: Move session files to the OS trash/recycle bin for delete actions from History, Pinned, Search, or the Command Palette (recommended). When disabled, delete them permanently.
cfg.resumeOpenTarget: How 'Resume in Codex' opens the session (sidebar or panel). Default is sidebar.
cfg.resumeOpenTarget.enumSidebar: Resume in the Codex sidebar (recommended default).
cfg.resumeOpenTarget.enumPanel: Resume in a Codex panel tab.
cfg.uiLanguage: Choose the display language used by this extension. Auto follows VS Code's display language.
cfg.uiLanguage.enumJapanese: Always show this extension in Japanese.
cfg.uiLanguage.enumEnglish: Always show this extension in English.
cfg.uiTimeGuideEnabled: Show the date guide and bookmark actions in session views and File AI Change History.
cfg.uiAlwaysShowHeaderActions: Always show view header action icons (sets VS Code setting 'workbench.view.alwaysShowHeaderActions').
cfg.historyDateBasis: Choose which session date is used by the history tree and date-based search filters.
cfg.historyDateBasis.enumStarted: Group history and apply date filters using the session start date.
cfg.historyDateBasis.enumLastActivity: Group history and apply date filters using the latest session activity date.
cfg.historyTitleSource: Choose how session titles are displayed.
cfg.historyTitleSource.enumGenerated: Create titles from the session content.
cfg.historyTitleSource.enumNativeWhenAva: Prefer title metadata from Codex or Claude Code when available, and otherwise create titles from the session content.
cfg.sessionRowShowTimestamp: Show the timestamp in session rows in History, Pinned, and Search. When hidden, the timestamp remains available in the tooltip.
cfg.sessionRowShowProject: Show the project alias or path in session rows in History, Pinned, and Search. When hidden, the project information remains available in the tooltip.
cfg.fileChangeHistoryExplorerContextMenu: Show 'File AI Change History' in file context menus in the VS Code sidebar file list.
cfg.webview.restoreAfterReload: Experimental. After Reload Window or a VS Code restart, restore open session tabs (including the reusable preview), File AI Change History, History Insights, and the dedicated Settings page. Session tabs and history views also restore their view positions. Restoration is asynchronous and may appear later; opening the same history before it finishes can create duplicate tabs. Tabs whose original session or target file is missing are not restored. This is off by default, and changes take effect after the next Reload Window or VS Code restart.
cfg.autoRefreshEnabled: Watch session folders and automatically refresh history after file changes. This is off by default to avoid adding background watchers.
cfg.autoRefreshDebounceMs: Wait this long after detecting session file changes before refreshing. Multiple changes during the wait are merged into one refresh.
cfg.autoRefreshMinIntervalMs: Minimum interval between automatic history refreshes.
cfg.chatOpenPosition: Choose where a session opens in the session view when switching back to it.
cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumTop: Open from the top when no target message is specified.
cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumLastMessage: Restore near the last viewed message.
cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumLatest: Open at the latest rendered card.
cfg.chatPerformanceMode: Choose the default session view performance mode. Auto switches based on session size and diff count, Normal View preserves view state as much as possible, and Lightweight View loads diffs and details on demand.
cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumAuto: Automatically choose Normal View or Lightweight View based on history size and diff count.
cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumNormal: Preserve the view state as much as possible. Large sessions may take longer to load or switch back to.
cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumSimplified: Load diffs and details on demand, and lighten heavy rendered sections when the view is restored.
cfg.chatToolDisplayMode: Choose how tool activity is shown in the history view.
cfg.chatToolDisplayMode.enumDetailsOnly: Keep the current behavior. Tool items appear only when details are shown.
cfg.chatToolDisplayMode.enumCompactCards: Always show tool cards, while 'Show details' only controls raw tool details and notes.
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding: Choose how long user messages are collapsed in the history view.
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumOff: Keep the current behavior. User messages are always fully expanded.
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumAuto: Collapse only long user messages when details are hidden.
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumAlway: Always start eligible user messages collapsed when details are hidden.
cfg.chatAssistantLongMessageFolding: Choose how long assistant messages are collapsed in the history view.
cfg.chatAssistantLongMessageFolding.enum: Keep the current behavior. Assistant messages are always fully expanded.
Collapse only long assistant messages when details are hidden.
Always start eligible assistant messages collapsed when details are hidden.
cfg.chatStickyUserPrompt: Show the current user prompt summary as a sticky header in the history view. Already-open history views are not updated immediately; reload or reopen the history view after changing this setting.
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode: Choose the turn display for Codex and Claude Code sessions. Basic shows turn boundaries, duration, item and token summaries, and completed-turn folding. Live also enables running turns, elapsed-time updates, activity cues, and a fixed locator for the running position.
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumOff: Do not add turn timeline UI.
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumBasic: Show turn start/end markers, range rails, duration, item/token summaries, and manual folding for completed turns. Live running indicators and elapsed live updates are disabled.
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumLive: Add running turn indicators, elapsed live updates, activity cues, and a fixed locator on top of Basic.
cfg.imagesEnabled: Show supported image attachments in the history view.
cfg.imagesMaxSizeMB: Set the maximum image file size loaded for preview and saving. Images over the limit cannot be previewed or saved.
cfg.imagesThumbnailSize: Choose the thumbnail size used for image attachments in the history view.
cfg.debugLoggingEnabled: Write diagnostic timing logs to the Codex History Viewer output channel. Logs include counts and durations, not session paths or message content.
cmd.pinnedSortPinnedAtDesc: Sort Pinned by Pin Date (Newest First)
cmd.pinnedSortPinnedAtAsc: Sort Pinned by Pin Date (Oldest First)
cmd.pinnedSortCreatedDesc: Sort Pinned by Started Date (Newest First)
cmd.pinnedSortCreatedAsc: Sort Pinned by Started Date (Oldest First)
cmd.pinnedSortLastActivityDesc: Sort Pinned by Last Activity Date (Newest First)

cmd.pinnedSortTitleAsc: Sort Pinned by Name (A to Z)
cmd.pinnedSortTitleDesc: Sort Pinned by Name (Z to A)
cmd.pinnedSortFileSizeDesc: Sort Pinned by File Size (Largest First)
cmd.pinnedSortFileSizeAsc: Sort Pinned by File Size (Smallest First)
cfg.agentRunsEnabled: Experimental setting. Enable Agent Runs for Codex and Claude Code sessions. Sub-agent sessions with a verified, available parent are shown through Agent Runs instead of the History list. Search and statistics include their own records regardless of this setting. Off by default.
cfg.resumeCodexMethod: Choose the resume actions for Codex sessions. CLI only enters a command in a new integrated terminal, so press Enter to run it. With Extension and CLI, the last successful method becomes the main button.
cfg.resumeClaudeMethod: Choose the resume actions for Claude Code sessions. CLI only enters a command in a new integrated terminal, so press Enter to run it. With Extension and CLI, the last successful method becomes the main button.
cfg.resumeMethod.enumExtension: Show only the extension resume action.
cfg.resumeMethod.enumCli: Show only the action that enters a CLI resume command in a new integrated terminal. Press Enter to run it.
cfg.resumeMethod.enumBoth: Show a split button for both methods, with the last successful method as the main action.
config.codexCompressedSessionsEnabled: Include compressed Codex histories (.jsonl.zst; experimental, off by default). Decompression can increase CPU and memory usage. Expanded files are not saved to disk.

cfg.title: Codex 历史记录查看器
cfg.sessionsRoot: Codex 会话根目录。留空使用默认位置（~/.codex/sessions）。
cfg.codexArchivedSessionsRoot: 在已启用来源中包含 Codex 且开启 Codex 归档会话时使用的根目录。留空使用与 Codex 会话根目录同级的 archived_sessions 文件夹。
cfg.codexArchivedSessionsEnabled: 当已启用来源包含 Codex 时，除常规会话外还加载 Codex archived_sessions。启用后，下方的归档会话根目录设置决定读取哪个归档文件夹。
cfg.claudeSessionsRoot: Claude Code 会话根目录。留空使用默认位置（~/.claude/projects）。
cfg.branchNavigationEnabled: 实验性设置。为 Codex 本地分支历史，以及通过“创建对话分支”生成的 Claude Code 历史启用分支导航。不支持在新工作树中创建的 Codex 分支。默认关闭。
cfg.sourcesEnabled: 选择历史记录、置顶和搜索中使用的一个或多个来源。移除 Codex 也会禁用 Codex 归档会话设置。
cfg.handoffEnabled: 为可见的 Codex 和 Claude Code 会话显示跨助手交接操作。关闭后隐藏交接文件创建、复制和打开操作，但仍可删除交接文件和查看状态信息。
cfg.previewOpenOnSelection: 选择树状列表项目时，在编辑器区域打开可复用的会话预览。
cfg.previewMaxMessages: 为详细悬浮提示获取的用户和助手消息数量上限，并不保证全部可见。VS Code 将悬浮提示高度限制在窗口的约 50%，内容较长时部分消息可能在可见区域之外。
cfg.previewTooltipMode: 选择会话树状列表悬浮提示显示的信息量。
cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumFull: 显示日期、来源、工作目录、标签或备注、消息摘要和操作帮助。
cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumCompact: 仅显示元数据，不含消息摘要或操作帮助。
cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumTitleOnly: 仅显示与树状列表项目相同的单行文本。
cfg.searchMaxResults: 设置单次搜索收集的最大命中数。
cfg.searchCaseSensitive: 选择搜索时是否区分大小写。
cfg.searchDefaultRoles: 选择搜索时使用的一个或多个消息角色。
cfg.searchIndexToolContent: 选择搜索索引中保存的工具内容范围。包含工具内容有助于文件 AI 更改历史优先匹配相关会话。
cfg.searchIndexToolContent.labelToolCall: 消息 + 工具调用 + 结果
cfg.searchIndexToolContent.enumConversat: 仅搜索用户、助手和开发者消息。文件 AI 更改历史仍可使用，但由于文件名线索有限，相关会话排序可能不够准确。
cfg.searchIndexToolContent.enumToolCalls: 搜索消息、工具名称和参数，不含工具输出。
搜索消息、工具名称及参数和工具输出。
cfg.deleteUseTrash: 从历史记录、置顶、搜索或命令面板删除会话时，将文件移至系统回收站（推荐）。禁用后将永久删除。
cfg.resumeOpenTarget: “在 Codex 中继续”的打开位置（侧边栏或面板），默认为侧边栏。
cfg.resumeOpenTarget.enumSidebar: 在 Codex 侧边栏中继续（推荐的默认选项）。
cfg.resumeOpenTarget.enumPanel: 在 Codex 面板标签页中继续。
cfg.uiLanguage: 选择此扩展的显示语言，默认为简体中文。“自动”跟随 VS Code 的显示语言。
cfg.uiLanguage.enumAuto: 使用 VS Code 的显示语言。
cfg.uiLanguage.enumJapanese: 始终以日语显示此扩展。
cfg.uiLanguage.enumEnglish: 始终以英语显示此扩展。
cfg.uiTimeGuideEnabled: 在会话视图和文件 AI 更改历史中显示日期导航和书签操作。
cfg.uiAlwaysShowHeaderActions: 始终显示视图标题栏操作图标（设置 VS Code 选项 workbench.view.alwaysShowHeaderActions）。
cfg.historyDateBasis: 选择历史记录树和日期搜索筛选使用的会话日期依据。
cfg.historyDateBasis.enumStarted: 使用会话开始日期分组历史记录并应用日期筛选。
cfg.historyDateBasis.enumLastActivity: 使用会话最后活动日期分组历史记录并应用日期筛选。
cfg.historyTitleSource: 选择会话标题的显示方式。
cfg.historyTitleSource.enumGenerated: 根据会话内容生成标题。
cfg.historyTitleSource.enumNativeWhenAva: 优先使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 的标题元数据，没有时根据会话内容生成标题。
cfg.sessionRowShowTimestamp: 在历史记录、置顶和搜索的会话行中显示时间。隐藏后仍可在悬浮提示中查看。
cfg.sessionRowShowProject: 在历史记录、置顶和搜索的会话行中显示项目别名或路径。隐藏后仍可在悬浮提示中查看。
cfg.fileChangeHistoryExplorerContextMenu: 在 VS Code 侧边栏文件列表的右键菜单中显示“文件 AI 更改历史”。
cfg.webview.restoreAfterReload: 实验性设置。重新加载窗口或重启 VS Code 后，恢复已打开的会话标签页（包括可复用预览）、文件 AI 更改历史、历史记录统计和专用设置页。会话标签页和历史记录视图也会恢复浏览位置。恢复过程是异步的，可能稍后才显示；完成前打开相同历史记录可能产生重复标签页。原会话或目标文件不存在的标签页不会恢复。默认关闭，更改在下次重新加载窗口或重启 VS Code 后生效。
cfg.autoRefreshEnabled: 监视会话文件夹，在文件更改后自动刷新历史记录。为避免增加后台监听，默认关闭。
cfg.autoRefreshDebounceMs: 检测到会话文件更改后，等待指定时间再刷新。等待期间的多次更改合并为一次刷新。
cfg.autoRefreshMinIntervalMs: 自动刷新之间的最小间隔。
cfg.chatOpenPosition: 选择切回会话视图时打开的位置。
cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumTop: 未指定目标消息时从顶部打开。
cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumLastMessage: 恢复到上次浏览的消息附近。
cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumLatest: 打开到最新渲染的卡片。
cfg.chatPerformanceMode: 选择默认会话视图性能模式。“自动”根据会话大小和差异数量切换，“普通视图”尽量保留显示状态，“轻量视图”按需加载差异和详情。
cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumAuto: 根据历史记录大小和差异数量自动选择普通视图或轻量视图。
cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumNormal: 尽可能保留视图状态。较大的会话在加载或切回时可能需要更长时间。
cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumSimplified: 按需加载差异和详情，并在恢复视图时简化渲染开销较大的部分。
cfg.chatToolDisplayMode: 选择历史记录视图中工具活动的显示方式。
cfg.chatToolDisplayMode.enumDetailsOnly: 保持现有行为，仅在显示详情时显示工具项目。
cfg.chatToolDisplayMode.enumCompactCards: 始终显示工具卡片，“显示详情”仅控制原始工具详情和备注。
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding: 选择历史记录视图中用户长消息的折叠方式。
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumOff: 保持现有行为，用户消息始终完全展开。
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumAuto: 隐藏详情时，仅折叠用户长消息。
cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumAlway: 隐藏详情时，符合条件的用户消息默认折叠。
cfg.chatAssistantLongMessageFolding: 选择历史记录视图中助手长消息的折叠方式。
cfg.chatAssistantLongMessageFolding.enum: 保持现有行为，助手消息始终完全展开。
隐藏详情时，仅折叠助手长消息。
隐藏详情时，符合条件的助手消息默认折叠。
cfg.chatStickyUserPrompt: 在历史记录视图顶部固定显示当前用户提示词摘要。已打开的视图不会立即更新，更改后请重新加载或重新打开视图。
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode: 选择 Codex 和 Claude Code 会话的轮次显示方式。“基础”显示轮次边界、耗时、条目和词元汇总，并支持折叠已完成轮次。“实时”还显示运行中的轮次、已用时间更新、活动提示和运行位置的固定定位器。
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumOff: 不显示轮次时间线界面。
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumBasic: 显示轮次开始和结束标记、范围轨道、耗时、条目和词元汇总，并支持手动折叠已完成轮次。不显示实时运行指示和已用时间更新。
cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumLive: 在基础模式上增加运行轮次指示、实时已用时间更新、活动提示和固定定位器。
cfg.imagesEnabled: 在历史记录视图中显示支持的图片附件。
cfg.imagesMaxSizeMB: 设置为预览和保存而加载的图片文件大小上限。超过上限的图片无法预览或保存。
cfg.imagesThumbnailSize: 选择历史记录视图中图片附件的缩略图大小。
cfg.debugLoggingEnabled: 将诊断计时日志写入 Codex 历史记录查看器输出通道。日志包含计数和耗时，不包含会话路径或消息内容。
cmd.pinnedSortPinnedAtDesc: 按置顶日期排列置顶会话（最新优先）
cmd.pinnedSortPinnedAtAsc: 按置顶日期排列置顶会话（最早优先）
cmd.pinnedSortCreatedDesc: 按开始日期排列置顶会话（最新优先）
cmd.pinnedSortCreatedAsc: 按开始日期排列置顶会话（最早优先）
cmd.pinnedSortLastActivityDesc: 按最后活动日期排列置顶会话（最新优先）
cmd.pinnedSortLastActivityAsc: 按最后活动日期排列置顶会话（最早优先）
cmd.pinnedSortTitleAsc: 按名称排列置顶会话（升序）
cmd.pinnedSortTitleDesc: 按名称排列置顶会话（降序）
cmd.pinnedSortFileSizeDesc: 按文件大小排列置顶会话（最大优先）
cmd.pinnedSortFileSizeAsc: 按文件大小排列置顶会话（最小优先）
cfg.agentRunsEnabled: 实验性设置。为 Codex 会话启用智能体运行记录。分析父子关系后，有已知父会话的子智能体会话将从历史记录列表中移除，并显示在父会话内。默认关闭。
cfg.resumeCodexMethod: 选择 Codex 会话的继续操作。CLI 只会在新的集成终端中填入命令，需按回车执行。选择扩展和命令行时，上次成功的方式成为主按钮。
cfg.resumeClaudeMethod: 选择 Claude Code 会话的继续操作。CLI 只会在新的集成终端中填入命令，需按回车执行。选择扩展和命令行时，上次成功的方式成为主按钮。
cfg.resumeMethod.enumExtension: 仅显示通过扩展继续会话的操作。
cfg.resumeMethod.enumCli: 仅显示在新集成终端中填入 CLI 继续会话命令的操作，按回车执行。
cfg.resumeMethod.enumBoth: 以分裂按钮显示两种方式，上次成功的方式为主操作。
cfg.uiLanguage.enumChinese: 始终以简体中文显示此扩展（默认）。
